_comment: Answers to the open questions application forms keep asking, each built only from facts in profile.json. `match` are regular expressions on the question's wording; `confirmed: false` marks an answer with a part still to check.

answers.label: A process or workflow you improved
answers.text: At Example Corp I noticed that monthly HR reports were rebuilt by hand from three exports. I combined them into one validated workbook with a refresh step, which cut preparation from two days to half a day.
